# remove google docs/etc

Remove the Google Docs / Sheets / Slides "applications" from the setup, because they are not applications at all: each one just opens the document in the browser. They are, presumably, the launcher stubs that the Google Drive client ([[DOT-227]]) places in `/Applications`, so the intent is to stop installing or listing them without losing Drive itself.
